note: Gibraltar, read on gibraltarlaws.gov.gi (the Government of Gibraltar's consolidated laws) on 2026-10-31. Majority: the Minors Act 1962 (Act 1962-07), s. 4, made a person of full age at eighteen; that Act was repealed by the Children Act 2009 (Act 2009-24) from 14 January 2010, which defines a child as a person under 18 (s. 2) and voids a child's contracts for money lent or goods supplied other than necessaries (s. 144); so full age is 18 (my reading: the 2009 Act names no age of majority in a section of its own). A sixteen-year-old's consent to medical treatment is as effective as an adult's (s. 156A); emancipation by marriage isn't held. Work: the Employment Act (Act 1932-16, in force 1 May 1954, as consolidated), s. 29, calls a child a person under fifteen, and s. 30 bars a child from any industrial undertaking (save one where only the employer's family work) and s. 31 from any Gibraltar ship; the Shop Hours (Children and Young Persons) Regulations 1990 (LN 1990/161) bar a child from employment in or about a shop. So 15 is held as the general age (my reading: no rule found bars a child from every other employment). Performers: no rule found in the Employment Act, the Children Act 2009 or the shop regulations holds a performance to the age, so performers are free (my reading); the Act's night-work and risk limits for young persons under 18 (ss. 30(2), 31A) aren't held. Service: the Gibraltar Regiment Act 1998 (Act 1998-25, in force 15 October 1998) has the Regiment of a Regular Element and a Volunteer Reserve, its soldiers enlisted on terms the Act sets (s. 14, Schedule 4); it asks no one to serve, so service is none (the Volunteer Reserve's call-out under s. 18 binds only its members).

sources.title: Gibraltar: Minors Act (Act 1962-07), repealed (gibraltarlaws.gov.gi)
sources.said: Repealed by Act 2009-24 as from 14.1.2010 ... A person becomes of full age on attaining the age of eighteen

sources.title: Gibraltar: Children Act 2009 (Act 2009-24) (gibraltarlaws.gov.gi)
sources.said: “child” means a person who is under the age of 18; ... All contracts, whether by specialty or by simple contract, entered into by a child for the repayment of money lent or to be lent, or for goods supplied or to be supplied (other than contracts for necessaries), and all accounts stated with a child are absolutely void.

sources.title: Gibraltar: Employment Act (Act 1932-16), consolidated (gibraltarlaws.gov.gi)
sources.said: “child” means a person under the age of fifteen years; ... No child shall be employed in any industrial undertaking: ... No child shall be employed in any ship.

sources.title: Gibraltar: Shop Hours (Children and Young Persons) Regulations 1990 (gibraltarlaws.gov.gi)
sources.said: No child should be employed in or about a shop.

sources.title: Gibraltar: Gibraltar Regiment Act 1998 (Act 1998-25) (gibraltarlaws.gov.gi)
sources.said: The terms of enlistment for soldiers are set out in Schedule 4 to this Act. ... Every member of the Volunteer Reserve shall undergo such peace- time training as may be prescribed
